# Client portal

**When to use this** — You received a portal link from HireClix and want project progress, messages, or files—no Prioritize login.

## Steps

1. Open the link you were sent (`/portal/...`). Bookmark it; treat it like a password — don’t forward it widely.
2. Review phases, tasks, and status for the shared project.
3. Read and reply in the **messages** thread when the team asks a question.
4. Upload files when requested (brand assets, feedback docs, etc.).
5. Check back on the same link for status changes; email may also notify you when configured.

## Done when

You’ve answered open questions and can see current status without chasing Slack.

## If this happens

- **Link doesn’t work** — ask your HireClix contact to re-invite or send a fresh token.
- **Wrong project** — you may have multiple portal links; use the one named for this engagement.
